title: Film Independent Screenwriting Lab
summary: Two-week workshop in the first quarter of the year for emerging screenwriters with a fiction feature screenplay. Each fellow works one-on-one with a Creative Advisor and in group sessions, hears from guest speakers, and ends with a pitch event with industry executives. Applications need a cover letter, a complete feature screenplay, an artist statement and a logline and synopsis.
dateText: Dates not stated; see the applications page
deadlineNote: The page points to Film Independent's applications page for the deadline.
eligibility: Open to any writer with a completed draft of a feature-length project.
